## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `47950b64f8fd15f19a564edce7df510898ce08af`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration (the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line alone owes this review; no published spec schema and no governed path in the tree: ten files, all under `ui/packages/**` plus one changeset). Read: card #35955 body and all 16 comments, the PR body and file list, the net diff against main `3a81fb7586c` (merge base), and the 59 check-runs on the head: every non-skipped run is `success`; `UI Published Artifacts`, `Build Core` and the Test Core matrix are skipped by their own `if:` (full battery only / selector), which is by design on a pull request.

### ① Derived judgments

1. `@object-ui/types` TS face, `DataTableSchema.onColumnHide` (`data-display.ts`): a new optional member, a function of the column's `accessorKey` (string) returning void. Public-surface WIDENING, named right in the PR body, the changeset and claim amendment 7077379232. Pinned at compile time in `data-table-declared-keys-6882.test.ts` (declared, and exact shape); the dev's reverse leg (number instead of string turns it red, TS2344) shows the pin reads the declaration.
2. `@object-ui/types` zod face (`zod/data-display.zod.ts`): `onColumnHide: handlerKeyRefusal('onColumnHide', 'runtime-slot', …)`. Read in `tombstone.zod.ts`: `z.custom` with a predicate that is always false, optional. Accept-set effect, named precisely: before this head `BaseSchema.passthrough()` KEPT an authored `onColumnHide` unexamined; now any authored value (object, string, live function) is refused by name with the runtime-slot guidance, and a document without the key parses as before. So the authored accept set does not widen (the PR's claim is right), and the one change it does take is the by-name refusal of a key that was never declared and that no reader consumed before this head. That is the house runtime-slot shape (objectui#6124; the same disposition `floatingBar` took in #36021 under `Clause-②: yes (widening)` / `Metadata-protocol: none`, and `onColumnsReorder` before it). Right.
3. Mirror-parity ledger (`zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, `KnownDrift` on `data-display.zod.ts#DataTableSchema`): `onColumnHide` joins the entry; the count moves 91 to 92 keys over 51 entries. Right.
4. `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, exported `ObjectGridComponentProps.onColumnHide` (optional, a function of the field string): public-surface WIDENING (the type is re-exported from `src/index.tsx`, also under the deprecated `ObjectGridProps` alias). Forwarded onto the `data-table` node only when the host supplies it; the node is assembled from scratch (`const dataTableSchema: ObjectGridDataTableSchema`), so no authored grid key reaches the slot. Right.
5. `@object-ui/components` `data-table.tsx` `hideColumn`: one added optional call after the local hide; the table still hides in its own state with no host (the CONTROL case pins it). No declaration change. On Discard the table re-seeds from its producer's columns (the `columnsAreEquivalent` re-seed at line 2299), so a column the host restores comes back. Right.
6. `@object-ui/plugin-list` `ListView.tsx`: `hideColumnFromMenu` is internal and is handed to the grid only for `object-grid`; it writes through the eye's own `updateListedFields`, and two guards keep it from reporting a column already hidden or a key the list does not draw. No exported prop or type changes. Right.
7. SQL push-down: the diff adds no data read, no id materialisation and no in-app join; nothing to push down.

Should-fix (non-blocking, carry on a follow-up card): the objectui#6124 runtime-slot census `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/handler-keys-json-refusal-6124.test.ts` does not list `onColumnHide`, though it is an `on*` key in exactly the shape that census exists for. Its `DataTableSchema` siblings `onSelectionChange` / `onColumnsReorder` sit in `RUNTIME_SLOT` (60 rows, length-pinned) and in the `KeepsFunction` TS list, so each is pinned to refuse an authored action object with its own guidance, to refuse a live function, and to keep its function type. The census is hand-listed and not self-completing, which is why CI stays green. As a result, the PR's sentence "refused by name on the zod mirror" is true (I read it in the code) but no runtime test pins it: the parity ledger pins only the key's presence on both halves. The fix is to add the row to `RUNTIME_SLOT`, the `KeepsFunction` entry and the length pin (60 to 61, 82 to 83 ids). Carry on a follow-up card.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/35955-header-menu-hide-draft.md`: `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-list` at `patch`. All four are public at 18.6.0 (none is `private`), and the diff moves exactly these four. Right.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body, and on the card in amendment 7077379232, which replaces the claim's `no` (7076203461). Matches ① items 1 and 4: two optional members added to published declarations, nothing removed or renamed. Right.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`, in both bodies. Checked against the AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3 taxonomy: no new authorable key, no new accepted value and no new metadata type. The zod arm refuses a function-valued runtime slot that was never declared, and the house reads that as not authored metadata (① item 2, precedent #36021). Under `none` the level is `patch`, and the PR ships `patch`. Right. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviations (report 7077360866): (a) Clause-② flipped to `yes (widening)`: accepted, and the claim is amended on the card. (b) The file surface widened to `ui/packages/types`: accepted, declared in the amendment; the claim's ban on server, spec and CLI changes held (no `packages/**` path in the diff). (c) The draft opened after four pushes, the body written once: no effect on the contract. (d) Patch on all four packages: right, see ②. (e) Commit trailers: not a contract matter.
- open_questions, item 5's spec half: retiring `columnState` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` lines 6385 and 6733 on this head, the view item and the list overlay). This PR answers nothing here, correctly: it needs `packages/spec` under the spec-property-retirement route, which the claim excluded. ESCALATED to the dispatching seat, which owes the answer (the dev recommends A: a handover card under the playbook). Truthfulness: the PR body says the card "stays open for the spec half of item 5 … routed separately", and its Acceptance notes say "this PR leaves it to the seat". The card says "routed to the seat, not built here" (7077379232), and PR 3a's claim 7064104023 promised "retires later through a handover card". No such card exists as of this review (an issue search for `columnState` finds only #35955). The scope statement is true. "Is routed separately" reads ahead of the record, though, so the seat should file the card and link it on #35955 before the remainder is taken as routed.
- Closing keyword: the PR body opens `Part of #35955`; no fixes/closes/resolves keyword appears in the body or in any of the four commit messages (the first commit's title carries `(#35955)`, which is not a keyword). Right for a card that stays open for item 5, and `PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path)` is green.
- Flag noted, not a finding: on a system view or fallback tab, `persistHiddenFields` records nothing (ruling 5839344270 B), so a header-menu hide there behaves exactly as the eye does. That matches the card's rule that this path follows the eye.
- `security_findings: none`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`: nothing to answer.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `da38b4814890b937986298543557d1215e367c26`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration, as before. The `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line alone owes this review. There is no published spec schema and no governed path in the tree. The file list is still the same eleven paths, all under `ui/packages/**` plus one changeset. This is a delta record on the PASS record 7077495388 at `47950b64`. That record carried one should-fix, S1 (the runtime-slot census row).

Read this round: the record 7077495388; the delta `47950b64..da38b481`; card #35955 comments after that record (area note 7077593461 and the rework report 7078028428); the PR body and file list at this head; issue #36403; and the 62 check-runs on the head.

Delta shape: one commit, `da38b481`, whose only parent is `47950b64`. There is no merge commit in the range, so no merge from main brings anything in. The merge base with main is still `3a81fb7586c`. The commit touches one file, `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/handler-keys-json-refusal-6124.test.ts`, with 15 lines added and 5 removed. No source file, declaration or changeset moves.

Check-runs on the head: 47 success, 15 skipped, none failed. The skipped runs are skipped by their own `if:` conditions (full battery only, opt-in or selector), as on the previous head. `Test UI` (all 16 shards), `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Check Changeset` and `PR-body guards` are green.

S1: closed

S1 asked for three things in the census file. All three are in `da38b481`:
- A `RUNTIME_SLOT` row `['data-display.zod.ts', 'DataTableSchema', 'onColumnHide', DataTableZod]`, placed next to its siblings `onSelectionChange` and `onColumnsReorder`.
- A `KeepsFunction` entry for `DataTableSchema['onColumnHide']` in the compile-time list.
- The length pins moved: `RUNTIME_SLOT` 60 to 61, the distinct-id set 82 to 83, and the docblock figure 60 to 61. `RETIRED` stays at 22.

The row now runs through every `it.each(ALL_SITES)` case in the file. So the key is pinned as declared on the mirror shape with the objectui#6124 guidance. It is pinned to refuse an authored action object by name, with code `custom` and its own message. It is pinned to refuse a live function. It is pinned to parse green without the key. It is also checked for the `RUNTIME SLOT` wording. The zod arm at this head is `handlerKeyRefusal('onColumnHide', 'runtime-slot', 'Column hide handler')`, so every one of these holds by reading. `Test UI` is green on the head. The PR's sentence "refused by name on the zod mirror" is now pinned at runtime, not only true in the code. No other file in the tree carries the old 60 or 82 figure.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Items 1 to 7 of record 7077495388 stand unchanged. The delta moves no source, no declaration and no zod arm, so no accept set and no public surface changes in this range.
2. The delta itself is test-only. It adds the census row, the type entry and the count moves named under S1. It changes nothing published. Right.
3. SQL push-down: the delta adds no data read, no id materialisation and no in-app join. Nothing to push down.

Nit N1 (no effect on the contract): the PR body still describes the earlier head. Its Tests list names `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` and `data-table-declared-keys-6882.test.ts` as updated, but not `handler-keys-json-refusal-6124.test.ts`. Its What-changes bullet says the parity ledger and the declared-keys pin carry the key, and leaves out the census. Its Runs block reads "head 47950b64 unless noted" and notes no run on `da38b481`. The rework report 7078028428 carries the head's runs, so the evidence exists. The dev may add one line to the Tests list. This does not block.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset `.changeset/35955-header-menu-hide-draft.md` is unchanged in the delta. It still lists `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-list` at `patch`. A test file is not published, so the delta needs no changeset change. Right.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is still line-initial in the PR body and the changeset body, and on the card in amendment 7077379232. The delta adds no surface, so the line still matches. Right.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` still holds. Under `none` the level is `patch`, and the PR ships `patch`. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Rework report 7078028428, deviation "push before overlap-check": the dev ran overlap-check on the same head right after the push. It was clean against main, every open PR and `--pr=36357`. Not a contract matter. Accepted.
- Rework report 7078028428, deviation "local narrowing": the `ui` scripts vitest family was not re-run on `da38b481` because the lock timed out. The delta touches one types test file and no `ui/scripts` input. That family ran green on `47950b64`, and CI `Test UI` is green on this head. Accepted.
- The deviations from round 1 (Clause-② flip, file surface, draft timing, patch level, trailers) were answered in record 7077495388 and are not reopened.
- `open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`. Nothing to answer.
- Follow-up routing, escalated last round: closed. The PR body now says the card "stays open for the spec half of item 5 (the view schema's `columnState` key), which needs `packages/spec` and is routed to #36403." Issue #36403 exists and is open: "Retire the server-side column state key (columnState) from view metadata". It names #35955 as its parent, follows the spec-property-retirement playbook, and declares `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` for that later PR. The card links it in area note 7077593461 and says the card stays open until #36403 lands. So the routing sentence is now true on the record.
- Closing keyword: the body still opens `Part of #35955`. The delta commit message carries no fixes, closes or resolves keyword. Right for a card that stays open. `PR-body guards` is green.
